headline: Congress named the Postal Service building at 907 Fourth Avenue in Lake Odessa, Michigan, the "Donna Sauers Besko Post Office."
what_it_does: This law gives a specific post office building in Lake Odessa, Michigan, a new official name honoring Donna Sauers Besko. It changes only the name of the facility. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or how the building operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018.
